**Answer: 3 of the 25 obligor groups with an approved limit are over it as of 30 Sep 2026.** Exposure here means active credit-facility commitments plus derivatives exposure, with every subsidiary the group controls rolled up to the top parent at all levels.

| Group (top parent) | Limit | Committed loans/lines | Derivatives exposure | Total | Use | Over by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brightwater Group Inc (LE‑10030) | $200.0M | $236.6M (21 facilities, 13 clients) | $0 | **$236.6M** | **118.3%** | **$36.6M** |
| Halvorsen Industrial Group Inc (LE‑10001) | $300.0M | $308.0M (10 facilities, 10 clients) | $36.3M | **$344.3M** | **114.8%** | **$44.3M** |

- **These are commitment breaches.** Halvorsen's loan and line commitments alone ($308.0M) already exceed its limit. Counting only drawn balances plus derivatives exposure, no group is over: Corvane would be at 87.6%, Halvorsen 86.8% and Brightwater 85.6%. The undrawn lines are what push them over.
- **Groups close to their limit:**
  - Stellmark Group: $164.7M of $180M (91.5%). Stellmark also holds a 35% non-controlling stake in Stellmark‑Orsa Ventures JV, which has a $30M facility. If that JV were counted, Stellmark would be at $194.7M, or 108%.
  - Ridgeport Group: $108.1M of $120M (90.1%), plus $8.3M of charged-off balances that I excluded.
  - Marrowind Holdings: 82.9%.
  - Valewood Capital Holdings: 81.1%.

  - Ridgeport Specialty Chemicals ($25M) moved to Sorvik Chemical Holdings on 1 Apr 2026.
  - The old hierarchy table (last updated 30 Nov 2024) still places both in their former groups and often stops at an intermediate parent. Totals built on it would be wrong.

- **Limits:** the risk warehouse's credit-limit table (25 rows, all obligor-group limits, all due for review 31 Dec 2026).
- **Group membership:** the current ownership table, keeping only links marked as controlling (51–100% owned) and in force on 30 Sep 2026. I walked these up to 7 levels to find each entity's top parent. Every subsidiary has at most one controlling parent and there are no ownership loops. Minority stakes (23–46%, not controlling) are excluded.
- **Matching to bank clients:** each legal entity's client number, padded with zeros to the bank's 10-digit format. All 297 group clients matched.
- **Loans:** active facilities only, using drawn plus undrawn at 30 Sep 2026, which equals the commitment. Paid-off and charged-off facilities are excluded.
- **Derivatives:** sum of current exposure (positive mark-to-market) on the 30 Sep 2026 snapshot, with one row per trade.

**Assumptions and limits**
- I measured limit use as commitments plus derivatives exposure. Using drawn balances instead clears all three breaches.
- Guarantees given by group members for borrowers outside the group are not counted.
- Collateral and other credit-risk mitigation are not netted.
- I ignored a sandbox table holding a Halvorsen exposure figure. It is dated March 2025, marked "direct subs only, WIP", and not authoritative.

WITH cur AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
up AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, p1.p a1, p2.p a2, p3.p a3, p4.p a4, p5.p a5, p6.p a6, p7.p a7, p8.p a8
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN cur p1 ON p1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN cur p2 ON p2.c=p1.p LEFT JOIN cur p3 ON p3.c=p2.p LEFT JOIN cur p4 ON p4.c=p3.p LEFT JOIN cur p5 ON p5.c=p4.p LEFT JOIN cur p6 ON p6.c=p5.p LEFT JOIN cur p7 ON p7.c=p6.p LEFT JOIN cur p8 ON p8.c=p7.p)
SELECT CASE WHEN a1 IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN a2 IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN a3 IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a4 IS NULL THEN 3 WHEN a5 IS NULL THEN 4 WHEN a6 IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN a7 IS NULL THEN 6 WHEN a8 IS NULL THEN 7 ELSE 8 END depth, COUNT(*) FROM up GROUP BY CASE WHEN a1 IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN a2 IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN a3 IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a4 IS NULL THEN 3 WHEN a5 IS NULL THEN 4 WHEN a6 IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN a7 IS NULL THEN 6 WHEN a8 IS NULL THEN 7 ELSE 8 END

WITH cur AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
up AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(p8.p,p7.p,p6.p,p5.p,p4.p,p3.p,p2.p,p1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN cur p1 ON p1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN cur p2 ON p2.c=p1.p LEFT JOIN cur p3 ON p3.c=p2.p LEFT JOIN cur p4 ON p4.c=p3.p LEFT JOIN cur p5 ON p5.c=p4.p LEFT JOIN cur p6 ON p6.c=p5.p LEFT JOIN cur p7 ON p7.c=p6.p LEFT JOIN cur p8 ON p8.c=p7.p),
cm AS (SELECT ENTITY_ID, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, COUNT(*) nt FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY ENTITY_ID)
SELECT l.LIMIT_ID, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID root, le.ENTITY_NM, l.LIMIT_AMT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cur WHERE cur.c=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID) root_has_parent,
COUNT(u.ENTITY_ID) n_ent, SUM(CASE WHEN u.CIF_REF IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_cif, SUM(cm.ce) cm_exp, SUM(cm.nt) n_trades
FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN up u ON u.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN cm ON cm.ENTITY_ID=u.ENTITY_ID
GROUP BY l.LIMIT_ID, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, l.LIMIT_AMT ORDER BY l.LIMIT_ID

SELECT SNAP_DT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT TRADE_ID) dt, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, SUM(CASE WHEN MTM_AMT<0 AND CURRENT_EXPOSURE>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) odd, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT ORDER BY SNAP_DT
SELECT PRODUCT, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(NOTIONAL_AMT) notl FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY PRODUCT

WITH cur AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
up AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(p8.p,p7.p,p6.p,p5.p,p4.p,p3.p,p2.p,p1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN cur p1 ON p1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN cur p2 ON p2.c=p1.p LEFT JOIN cur p3 ON p3.c=p2.p LEFT JOIN cur p4 ON p4.c=p3.p LEFT JOIN cur p5 ON p5.c=p4.p LEFT JOIN cur p6 ON p6.c=p5.p LEFT JOIN cur p7 ON p7.c=p6.p LEFT JOIN cur p8 ON p8.c=p7.p)
SELECT l.LIMIT_ID, STRING_AGG(CAST(u.CIF_REF AS varchar(max)), ',') cifs FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l JOIN up u ON u.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID WHERE u.CIF_REF IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.LIMIT_ID ORDER BY l.LIMIT_ID

SELECT f.FACILITY_STATUS, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit, COUNT(b.FACILITY_ID) n_bal, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT) bal_tot, SUM(IFF(ABS(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT-f.COMMIT_AMT)>1,1,0)) mismatch FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT FACILITY_ID) d, COUNT(DISTINCT FACILITY_ID, SNAP_DT) dk FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT FACILITY_ID), 0 FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY

SELECT LENGTH(CIF_NO) l, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_NO) FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT 100+LENGTH(CIF_NO), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_NO) FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.*, e.ENTITY_NM, e.CIF_REF, pe.ENTITY_NM parent_nm FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP o JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e ON e.ENTITY_ID=o.CHILD_ENTITY_ID JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY pe ON pe.ENTITY_ID=o.PARENT_ENTITY_ID WHERE o.CHILD_ENTITY_ID IN ('LE-10007','LE-10101','LE-10013','LE-10086','LE-10044','LE-10064','LE-10079') ORDER BY 1,5

WITH cur AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
up AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(p8.p,p7.p,p6.p,p5.p,p4.p,p3.p,p2.p,p1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN cur p1 ON p1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN cur p2 ON p2.c=p1.p LEFT JOIN cur p3 ON p3.c=p2.p LEFT JOIN cur p4 ON p4.c=p3.p LEFT JOIN cur p5 ON p5.c=p4.p LEFT JOIN cur p6 ON p6.c=p5.p LEFT JOIN cur p7 ON p7.c=p6.p LEFT JOIN cur p8 ON p8.c=p7.p)
SELECT u.ENTITY_ID, u.CIF_REF, u.ult cur_ult, h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID legacy_ult, h.LAST_SYNC_DT FROM up u FULL JOIN dbo.CPTY_HIER_LEGACY h ON h.ENTITY_ID=u.ENTITY_ID
WHERE (u.ult IN (SELECT ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT) OR h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT)) AND (h.ENTITY_ID IS NULL OR u.ENTITY_ID IS NULL OR u.ult<>h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID) AND u.ENTITY_ID<>u.ult

SELECT f.CIF_NO, c.CLIENT_NM, COUNT(*) n_fac, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT) committed, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO=f.CIF_NO JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' WHERE f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND f.CIF_NO IN ('0000041012','0000041045','0000041070','0000041090','0000041099','0000041005','0000041123') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT g.GUARANTOR_ENTITY_ID, e.ENTITY_NM, g.FACILITY_ID, g.GUAR_AMT, g.GUAR_TYP FROM dbo.GUARANTEE g JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e ON e.ENTITY_ID=g.GUARANTOR_ENTITY_ID WHERE g.STATUS='ACTIVE' AND g.EFF_DT<='2026-09-30' AND g.EXP_DT>='2026-09-30' AND g.GUAR_TYP<>'PARENT' AND g.GUARANTOR_ENTITY_ID BETWEEN 'LE-10001' AND 'LE-10069'
